story.summaryEn:
Signed, sealed, delivered. 🇧🇷✍️
We're excited to announce the signing of Rafael Câmara on a multi-year contract.
The Brazilian racer will make the step up to Formula 1 at the start of the 2027 season.
#HaasF1 #F1
detailZh:
签了，封了，发了。🇧🇷✍️
我们很高兴地宣布，Rafael Câmara与车队签订了多年合约。
这位巴西车手将在2027赛季开始时晋升到一级方程式赛车的行列。
#HaasF1 #F1
